items.title: How much does 'just in case' headroom actually cost?
items.description: Grounded in this unit's staging example: measured peak need was about 1.2x normal load, and the base right-sized cost for that need is about $900/month. Drag the safety-margin multiplier to see what provisioning above that measured peak actually costs — this is the direct dollar cost of 'just in case' sizing, and why L1's staging environment (provisioned at roughly 3.3x the measured peak, near $3,600/month) sat so far into the wasteful zone.
items.compute: const baseCostAtMeasuredPeak = 900; const monthlyCostUsd = Math.round(baseCostAtMeasuredPeak * params.marginMultiplier); return { monthlyCostUsd };

items.title: Will this month's spend blow the budget before it ends?
items.description: Grounded in this unit's forecast example: a $10,000/month budget, ten days into a thirty-day period, spending at a daily rate that can be dialed up or down. Drag the current daily spend rate to see the forecasted month-end total — the same trajectory-based check that would have flagged L1's tripling bill weeks before the invoice did, instead of waiting for spend-so-far alone to cross the line.
items.compute: const budgetUsd = 10000; const periodDays = 30; const forecastedSpendUsd = Math.round(params.dailySpendRateUsd * periodDays); return { forecastedSpendUsd };
